Class PlexModule

java.lang.Object
dev.plex.module.PlexModule
public abstract class PlexModule extends Object
Base class for Plex modules.

Use api() for Plex services. Register native Paper tasks with ownTask(ScheduledTask) so Plex can cancel them when the module unloads.

    • registerCommand

      public void registerCommand(PlexCommand command)
      Registers and tracks a command owned by this module.

      Register commands in load() to use them during the current server run. Later changes usually require a server restart.

      Parameters:
      command - command to register

    • unregisterCommand

      public void unregisterCommand(PlexCommand command)
      Unregisters and stops tracking a command owned by this module.

      The command can remain active until Paper rebuilds its command list. This usually happens after a server restart.

      Parameters:
      command - command to unregister

    • getResource

      @Nullable public @Nullable InputStream getResource(@NotNull @NotNull String filename)
      Opens a resource owned by this module.

      Plex module class loaders delegate to Plex's class loader. This method searches the module class loader itself first so common paths such as config.yml cannot resolve to a resource bundled by Plex.

      Parameters:
      filename - resource path
      Returns:
      resource stream, or null when the resource cannot be opened
